runner_schedule.meaning: every 10 minutes: up to 20 proof windows, each in its own transaction under the 8 s limit

owner_decision: 8 Oct 2026 (8, PL-8): arahkan penjalan bukti otomatis di server. Bukti harus diperiksa terhadap versi sumber dan tidak boleh tetap dianggap berlaku setelah koreksi atau pembatalan. 11 Oct 2026: selesaikan CP7 (termasuk K6), lalu audit penuh CP7.

runner.entry: pg_cron every 10 minutes: set statement_timeout to '8s'; then 20 x (begin; select cp7_ops.proof_tick(); commit;) -> cp7_proof_runner.prove_next()
runner.window: prove_next proves one window of the posted cutting history, by group id after the pass cursor, at the pass clock, through the unchanged PL-8 prover cp7_supply_native.prove_exhausted (window 200 groups, capture batches of 50); a pass ends at the last group and the runner rests 1 hour, then starts the next pass at a new clock
runner.proof_meaning: unchanged PL-8 part 3: a proof binds the group's own captured fact rows (facts_hash) and the classifier's definition (kernel_version); a correction, reversal or backdated row changes the hash, so the old proof is never matched again (the group is classified anew by a capture or by the next pass); proofs are only added, never changed or deleted
runner.statement_limit: refused (55000 CP7_RUNNER_STATEMENT_LIMIT_REQUIRED) unless the session's statement_timeout is set and at most 8000 ms; a window stopped by the limit stores nothing and the next call halves the window (200, 100, 50); a 50-group window stopped three times in a row is skipped, recorded in the pass (first/last group, code, sqlstate) and its groups stay unproven until the next pass
runner.refusals: a capture batch refusal inside a window is handled like a stop and recorded with its code; without a proof kernel (CP7_SUPPLY_PROOF_KERNEL) the refusal is recorded and the runner rests 1 hour with the cursor unchanged
runner.concurrency: one call proves at a time: the private lock hashtextextended('CP7:K6_PROOF_RUNNER',0) is taken with pg_try_advisory_xact_lock; a call that does not get it returns BUSY having read and written nothing (no call waits on another, also on a fresh installation); a capture during a window may store the same proof (no unique key, so neither waits) and reads it as one
runner.private: cp7_ops.proof_tick() SECURITY DEFINER as cp7_capture, EXECUTE for postgres only; schema cp7_proof_runner (prove_next, status; tables state: one row updated in place, never deleted; passes: insert-only) private to cp7_capture; no public RPC

synthetic_steps: SYNTHETIC administrative clones of one finished cutting group (PL-8 suite helper clone_groups), labelled
TEST_REST_OVERRIDE: the hour between passes ended early on the disposable copy (state.rest_until moved back), labelled
TEST_SCHEDULE_OVERRIDE every 5 seconds on the disposable race copy
the proof table locked by a test session (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE) to hold a window inside its statement limit
